sources.summary: Original field report by 杨洁 attributes current regional customer service and intelligent-compute supply/demand to centre representative 贾晋宁. Reporter observation of power/card-use monitoring is separate corroboration of existing operation.
sources.date_semantics: September 14 is the original China Securities Journal publication confirming the reported present state. The exact visit/interview date is not supplied. The article explicitly places initial resource-pool construction in 2024; that historical year is not the selected confirmation date or a precise opening date.

firsthand_status_statement.speaker: 贾晋宁
firsthand_status_statement.speaker_role: 中国电信京津冀智能算力中心相关负责人 (a representative responsible for the named centre; exact job title unspecified)
firsthand_status_statement.project_identity: 中国电信京津冀智能算力中心 in Tianjin Wuqing
firsthand_status_statement.statement: The named centre representative describes the existing deployment as serving customers around Beijing and says intelligent-compute demand currently exceeds supply. This supports current operation of existing facilities, without assigning all campus buildings an operational state.
firsthand_status_statement.date_semantics: September 14 is the original China Securities Journal publication confirming the reported present state. The exact visit/interview date is not supplied. The article explicitly places initial resource-pool construction in 2024; that historical year is not the selected confirmation date or a precise opening date.
firsthand_status_statement.review: Accept only existing operational facilities at the named campus. The named centre representative describes serving customers in the Beijing-surrounding region and current demand exceeding available intelligent-compute supply. This participant statement is distinct from the reporter observation of a control screen displaying power/card use, which corroborates actual operation. Neither statement identifies all operating buildings, proves completion of the whole campus, or completes Phase 4. The 2024 construction sentence alone would be insufficient for current status.
